caption_L1: Here a is a bar plot called Leading rum brands worldwide in 2019 , based on sales volume (in million 9 liter cases). There is a linear scale with a minimum of 0 and a maximum of 20 along the y-axis, labeled Million 9 liter cases. caption_L2L3: Tanduay is the highest selling rum brand in the world as of 2019 with Appleton Jamaica and Negrita the joint lowest selling. Predictably, larger more well established brands are the most popular, with smaller ones selling on a smaller scale.
